assign.outcome: **Verdict: embed YouTube now, defer `videos.insert` upload.** The site's existing labs (`/imagine/youtube/`, `/imagine/feeds/video/`) already use only the IFrame Player API — zero quota, zero OAuth. Data API v3 `videos.insert` now runs in its own bucket (100 calls/day, 1 unit each — a big, live, self-contradicted change on Google's own docs, see log #3 vs #5), but unverified projects upload **private-only** until a compliance audit passes (log #4) — a bad first-upload experience, so upload waits. [`verdict.md`](/imagine/platform/research/video/verdict/) has the full §33 record, three numbers, and cut list. [`log.jsonl`](/imagine/platform/research/video/log/), 41 entries (24 established / 4 contested / 13 speculation opinions+questions), `--check` clean (0 torn, 0 refused). Left open: whether `youtube.upload` triggers the $15k-75k CASA assessment or just the free sensitive-scope path (log #9) — no static scope-tier list exists; and whether the new 100/day upload bucket is confirmed empirically anywhere (log #6) — both closed as honest questions, not guesses.
